facts.fact: The World Bank's PRODIGY mission of 1 to 4 December 2025 reports 336 communes using the digital civil-registration system SIECM, with 61,892 birth certificates carrying a unique identity number issued; its offline module was still only in demonstration since November, so the communes in use were working in the system without it. The document does not say how the commune offices are connected.
facts.system: SIECM (système d'enregistrement numérique des faits d'état civil)

facts.fact: The World Bank mission of December 2025 counts 336 communes using the digital civil-registration system SIECM, which it puts at 40% of the project target; it gives no national total of communes, and says a further 112 trained communes were not yet operational and others not yet equipped.

facts.fact: The World Bank mission of December 2025 says the number of communes using SIECM rose from 75 to 336 over the preceding six months.
